title: plan-preflight-failed silencioso: sem marker/notify + gitignore sidecar-session
description: Incidente 2026-07-08 (plan de CAM-115): `cam plan` escreveu phase:planning em .claude/cam-loop.local.md, o sidecar vivo detectou e chamou runPlanPhase, mas o pre-flight clean-tree recusou porque .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json estava untracked no working tree. runPlanPhase reverteu phase para idle e so escreveu um event plan-preflight-failed no cam-worker-events.jsonl. Sem marker durável, sem notify pro pane do orquestrador. Pro operador pareceu que o sinal nunca disparou. Duas facetas. (1) GATILHO: .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json nao esta no .gitignore, mas todos os 20+ irmaos runtime estao (.cam-orch-session, .cam-sidecar.pid, .cam-orch-ready etc). E arquivo runtime do sidecar, deve ser gitignored; senao suja o working tree e o clean-tree preflight (git status --porcelain, untracked-sensitive, src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:94-97) recusa todo plan/dispatch. (2) FALLBACK (o core do pedido): quando QUALQUER step do plan-preflight falha (clean-tree, typecheck, tests), o caminho preflight-failed -> no-action (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1137-1139) NAO dispara notifyFn e NAO escreve marker durável; exitPhaseAfterPlan (src/commands/sidecar.ts:1533) reverte pra idle. Contrasta com ship-stalled (src/release/merge-watch.ts:257 escreve .cam-ship-stalled.json, boot step 7 le) e plan-escalated (src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts:93 escreve .cam-plan-escalated.json, boot step 8 le): ambos tem marker durável + boot-read + notify. Preflight-failed nao tem analogo, entao se o orquestrador que disparou ja reciclou, a falha fica invisível. ACs propostos: (a) .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json adicionado ao .gitignore junto dos irmaos runtime; (b) plan-preflight-failed escreve marker durável .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json (schema analogo ao ship-stalled: step, detail, issueId, writtenAt) que o boot do subagent-orchestrator.md le como opening blocker e remove no proximo plan run convergente; (c) preflight-failed dispara notifyFn (send-keys) pro pane do orquestrador com step+detail; (d) typecheck + tests verdes. Questao de design pro grill/plan: manter o clean-tree preflight untracked-sensitive (--porcelain estrito), recomendado SIM (untracked inesperado deve bloquear pra nao carregar lixo pro branch novo) e resolver o gatilho via gitignore + surfacing, sem afrouxar o gate; a alternativa -uno deixaria lixo passar.

spec.scope: Close the silent plan-preflight-failure gap in the sidecar. When any plan-preflight step (clean-tree, typecheck, bun-test, git-pull, git-checkout-main) fails, the sidecar today reverts phase to idle and writes only a flight-recorder event (plan-preflight-failed) with no durable marker and no operator narration, so a recycled orchestrator never learns the plan attempt died. This issue adds the third durable surfacing marker (after ship-stalled and plan-escalated): a durable file plus best-effort pane notify plus orchestrator boot-read. It also fixes the gitignore trigger (the sidecar-session runtime file that caused the CAM-115 false refusal) and the identical latent gap on the ship-stalled marker. In scope: gitignore hygiene for the three untracked runtime artifacts, the new marker module mirroring plan-escalation, the runPostAuditAction preflight-failed arm (marker write plus notify plus distinct result kind), Option B removal, and the orchestrator boot step (both dual copies plus embed). Out of scope: loosening the clean-tree preflight to -uno (explicitly rejected), any change to the existing plan-preflight-failed event, and any change to the clean-tree, typecheck, or test steps themselves.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1 gitignore: .gitignore contains entries for .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json, .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json, and .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json. These are the three runtime artifacts currently untracked and not ignored, siblings of the already-ignored .cam-plan-escalated.json (.gitignore:85).

AC2 durable marker: a marker file .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json is written whenever a plan phase result kind is preflight-failed. Shape is { step: string, detail: string, writtenAt: string ISO 8601 }, with no issueId field. detail carries the full untruncated output of the failing step. writtenAt is stamped by the production seam in sidecar.ts, not by the pure loop; the pure loop returns the non-timestamp fields via an Omit<Marker, 'writtenAt'> writer-params type, mirroring PlanEscalationWriterParams. A read helper shape-guards all three fields.

AC3 runPostAuditAction arm: runPostAuditAction gains an explicit preflight-failed arm (it currently falls through to no-action at plan-runner.ts:1147). The arm writes the marker, fires notifyFn with a one-line send-keys narration, and returns a distinct PostAuditActionResult kind { kind: 'preflight-failed' }. exitPhaseAfterPlan handles the new kind by reverting phase to idle.

AC4 truncation: the notify narration and the boot blocker line truncate detail to its first line plus a (+N more) suffix when detail spans multiple lines. The runtime pane line mirrors the existing ship-stalled and plan-escalated pane format (step then detail). The durable marker keeps the full untruncated detail.

AC5 Option B removal: any plan phase result whose kind is not preflight-failed removes the marker (best-effort unlink). Marker present is equivalent to 'the last plan attempt died in preflight'. Removal is not gated on convergence and not gated on issueId.

AC6 boot-read: subagent-orchestrator.md gains a boot step (step 9) that reads .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json, surfaces it as an opening blocker using the AC4 truncation rule, and documents 'do not delete the marker yourself'. Both copies are updated: .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md and templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, and the embed is regenerated via bun run embed-vendor.

AC7 gate unchanged: the clean-tree preflight stays untracked-sensitive (strict git status --porcelain); it is not loosened to -uno. The trigger is resolved via gitignore hygiene (AC1) plus surfacing (AC2 to AC6), not by weakening the gate.
AC8 gates green: bun run typecheck reports zero errors, bun test reports zero failures, bun run check:all passes (biome), and bun run embed-vendor:check passes (templates touched).
gotchas: orchestrator.md is dual-copied (.claude/agents/ and templates/agents/) and embedded in src/vendor/_generated.ts; editing it requires updating both copies plus bun run embed-vendor, and the embed-vendor:check gate applies. cam dual-copy is per-file: diff before assuming byte-identity.

notifyFn (makeNotifyOrchestrator, host.ts:198) is best-effort and a silent no-op when the orchestrator pane is gone; the durable marker is the source of truth for surfacing, not the send-keys narration.
preflight-failed is issue-agnostic (clean-tree, typecheck, bun-test, git-pull are environment problems, not issue problems), which is why the marker carries no issueId and removal is not per-issue.

At the point preflight fails (inside runPlanPhase, plan-runner.ts:748), notifyFn is not in scope (only logEvent is); the marker write and notify must happen one layer up in runPostAuditAction (sidecar.ts:1773), where notifyFn is already constructed.

The preflight-failed path already writes a plan-preflight-failed event to cam-worker-events.jsonl (events.ts:115). This issue adds the durable marker plus notify plus boot-read; it does not change the event.
ship-stalled uses field name ts; plan-escalated uses writtenAt. Follow plan-escalated (writtenAt), the closer and newer sibling.
